newsitem.title: MEXICO: Tablex, Miller Milling form wheat exporting firm.
newsitem.headline: Tablex, Miller Milling form wheat exporting firm.

text.p: Mexico's Tablex said Tuesday it formed a new company with Miller Milling Company to produce and export semolina wheat to make pasta for the U.S., and Central and South American markets.

To be located in the northern Mexico state of Sonora, the new company will begin operations in the spring of 1998 with an intital investment of $15 million, Tablex said in a statement to the Mexican Stock Exchange.
Tablex did not provide more details of the alliance and spokesmen were not immediately available to elaborate.
